scripts.title: TVL 2 Script
scripts.features:
⚔️ Combat Features
• Anti-Screen Effects (hides effects such as sleep spell, necksnap etc..)
• Auto Head Siphon 🧠 (auto-completes the head siphon prompts, Legit or Rage pace)
• Auto Fightback ✊ (auto escapes when someone grabs you with Piggyback Attack)
• Auto Repel Crows 🐦 (auto escapes Starling Swarm)
• Auto Body Jump 👻 (automatically spams the button to finish the progress bar)
• Auto Ictus 👊 (pushes away enemies trying to super slap/kick you)

👁️ Awareness
• Player ESP (character name, display name with username, distance, backpack items, invis status, astral projection tracking with its owner)
• Show Display Name / Show Backpack / Distance toggles
• All Players / ESP Player Selector
• Invis Checker (shows whether a player is invisible in-game)
• Quest ESP (Trump Thief, Soul Coins, Paint Cans & Tomb Book)
• Blood Bag ESP 🩸
• Cure Notifier (tells you the moment someone gets cured)
• Staff List (every staff member in your server with their avatar and rank)
• Players Information (username, character, species)

🌱 Plant Awareness
• All Plants ESP (see every plant in-game, with the plant's own icon)
• Plant Selector (searchable)

🤖 Aim Assister
• Hitbox Extender (expands the target's visual hitbox)
• Range Extender (extends the range for abilities)
• Visualiser (dot above the target the Hitbox Extender is aiming at)
• Ignore Invisible Players / Respect Collision Barriers
• Exclude Friends (never targets your friends)

⚡ Premium Outspammer
• Outspammer (spams any ability at the target at insane speeds)
• Target Mode (hold/toggle) & Excluded Targets

📡 Pingless Outspammer
• Pingless Outspammer (outspam ANYBODY at HIGH Ping)
• Respect Ability Range, Target Mode & Excluded Targets

🔨 Tool Outspammer
• Tool Outspammer (spams any tool at the target at insane speeds)
• Silent Aim with Target Mode (Crosshair or Nearest)
• CPS slider, cooldown bursts, Excluded Targets

🎯 Premium Auto Steal
• Auto Steal (takes a character the instant its slot opens, open characters spawn immediately)
• Steal Now button & keybind

👤 Custom Auto Deploy
• Auto Custom Deploy (automatically deploys as your selected custom character)
• Saved Slot selector & keybind

🥤 Cola
• Buy any drink sold on your map straight from the menu, with the price shown in coins

🔥 Custom Incendia
• Color Picker (change the colour of fire bolt & fire circle)

🎨 Custom Wheel Unlocker
• Unlock Custom Wheel (gain access to the custom wheel)

👕 Outfits Loader
• Load Outfits (load any outfit onto yourself)

🔊 Ability Voicelines
• Enable Voicelines (adds voicelines to abilities in-game) with a volume slider

🪄 Compulsion
• Auto Compulsion (choose which compulsion option gets clicked automatically)

🌥️ Ambience
• Lock Weather (locks selected weather forever)
• Lock Time (locks selected time forever)

💀 Otherside
• Resurrect (come back to life infinite times)

⚙️ Essentials & Settings
• FPS Booster with Booster Levels
• Show Watermark (FPS, ping and live spammer status)
• RGB Accent 🌈
• Safe or Full mode picked at launch

💾 Configuration & Customization
• Auto-Save: configs save automatically for your next rejoin
• Config Sharing: share your profiles with friends
• Themes & Fonts: full UI colour styling, custom font selection, corner radius
• Background Image: add your own background image with opacity and fit

🔒 BUILT-IN AUTOCLICKER BYPASS INCLUDED 🔒
